agent_notes: Official identity and the Jodhpur campus address were verified from the AIIMS Jodhpur homepage footer; the official curriculum page links the programme-family catalogue and detailed curriculum documents used here.

The central official Courses List PDF is served from the institution website with a 131023 filename; current official curriculum and academic pages were also checked. Session notices marked Closed were treated as admission-session status, not as evidence that the underlying catalogue programme had ceased.
No duration or eligibility was inferred where the official curriculum did not explicitly state it; non-null values are limited to explicit statements in the cited official curriculum documents.

The official Post Basic Diploma page had no active notices and was not added. Post-doctoral fellowship entries were included because the official Curriculum page lists Fellowship Courses and links the official fellowship curriculum. The PG Diploma in Genetic Counselling and recurring Executive Program were included because current official academic catalogue pages identify them as programmes.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed-network self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests after confirming the expected search or aiimsjodhpur.edu.in hostname.
